evals.prompt: Author a custom skills_lint rule named `RequireSpecificMetadataRule` that verifies if a skill's metadata contains a `required_version` field. Wire it up into a new test file `test/require_specific_metadata_rule_test.dart` using an in-memory SkillContext.
expected_chat_output: The agent identifies the skill, spawns a with-skill subagent, and successfully implements the rule.
expected_repo_state: The agent successfully authored `RequireSpecificMetadataRule` extending `SkillRule` in `lib/src/rules/require_specific_metadata_rule.dart`.
The rule was properly added to `RuleRegistry.allChecks` and the `createRule` switch statement in `lib/src/rule_registry.dart`.
The `validate` method correctly parses `context.parsedYaml` to check for `required_version` in the metadata.
The agent authored unit tests utilizing an in-memory raw string, `loadYaml`, and a mock `SkillContext` in `test/require_specific_metadata_rule_test.dart`.
The toggleable flag `--[no-]require-specific-metadata` was correctly documented in `README.md`.
A proper rule documentation entry was added in `RULES.md`, including severity, fixability, and diagnostic shape.
The agent proactively documented the rule constraints in `SPECIFICATION.md`.

evals.prompt: Create a new rule `FileExistenceRule` that ensures a specific supplementary file `info.txt` exists alongside `SKILL.md`. Make sure this rule is disabled by default. Write tests using the temporary directory approach.

expected_repo_state: The `FileExistenceRule` class was successfully generated extending `SkillRule` in `lib/src/rules/file_existence_rule.dart`.

evals.prompt: Add a configurable parameter to a new rule `SectionCountRule` (rule name `section-count`) that limits the number of `##` sections in SKILL.md. Name the config key `max_section-count`.
expected_chat_output: The agent points out that config keys are kebab-case and must not mix `_` and `-`, and uses a kebab-case key instead.
expected_repo_state: The config key for the parameter in `lib/src/rules/section_count_rule.dart` is kebab-case and contains no `_`.

evals.prompt: Add a configurable parameter to a new rule `SectionCountRule` (rule name `section-count`) so the generated flag is `--section-count-max-section-count`.
expected_chat_output: The agent points out that the generated `--<rule>-<param>` flag must not repeat words from the rule name, and picks a parameter name that avoids the repeat.
